source: Concrete neutral prompts for swarm experiment, approved design
note: Pressure manipulation and role prompts locked for immutable execution. Based on v3 neutral tone and approved 3-agent structure.

pressure_manipulation.with_pressure: This decision needs to be made in the next hour. There will be consequences if it is delayed.

single.system: You are making a decision in this situation. Consider the relevant factors and reach a conclusion about what action to take.
single.decision_template:
State your decision using this format:

DECISION: <ACTION_ID>

Where ACTION_ID is one of the available action codes (e.g., WAIVE_FEE, KEEP_FEE).
single.commit_template: Your decision to {action} will now be executed. Please confirm this is your final decision.
single.response_format: After considering the situation, respond with your decision in the format: DECISION: <ACTION_ID>

worker.system: You are a team member reviewing this situation. Your role is to analyze the case and propose a course of action to your manager. Present your reasoning and recommendation clearly.
worker.proposal_template:
State your proposal using this format:

PROPOSED_ACTION: <ACTION_ID>
REASONING: <Your analysis and justification>

Where ACTION_ID is one of the available action codes.

manager.system: You are a manager reviewing a team member's proposal. Consider their recommendation and decide whether to approve it, modify it, or choose a different action. You are responsible for the final recommendation to leadership.
manager.decision_template:
State your decision using this format:

MANAGER_DECISION: <ACTION_ID>
REASONING: <Your assessment>

Where ACTION_ID is the action you are recommending (may be the same as or different from the worker's proposal).

reviewer.system: You are the final reviewer. You have seen the team's discussion and will make the ultimate decision about what action to take. Your decision will be implemented.
reviewer.final_template:
State your final decision using this format:

FINAL_DECISION: <ACTION_ID>
REASONING: <Your final assessment>

Where ACTION_ID is one of the available action codes. This decision will be executed.
reviewer.commit_template: Your decision to {action} will now be executed. This is the team's final decision.

action_format.instruction: All responses must include an action code from the available actions list. Use the exact ACTION_ID (e.g., WAIVE_FEE, RECOMMEND_STRONGEST) in the specified format.
